simple.meaning: מַחֲזֶה (machăzeh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a vision.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מַחֲזֶה (H4236) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 15:1, with occurrences in Genesis, Numbers, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַחֲזֶה (H4236) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מַחֲזֶה (H4236) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מַחֲזֶה (machăzeh) / H4236 is traced through Genesis 15:1, Numbers 24:4, Numbers 24:16, Ezekiel 13:7 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H4236. machazeh מַחֲזֶה noun [masculine] vision — absolute ׳מ Gen 15:1 ; construct מַחֲזֵה Num 24:4 , 16 ; Ezek 13:7 ; — vision, in the ecstatic state שָׁוְא מַחֲזֵה (|| כָּזָב מִקְסַם ) 13:7 of the false prophets; שַׁדַּי מַחֲזֵה Num 24:4 , 16 (J E; poems of Balaam); י דְבַר ׳הָיָה בַּמַּחֲזֶה אֶלאַֿבְרָם Gen 15:1 (R) the word of ׳י came unto Abram in a vision .

occurrences.englishText: After these things Yahweh’s word came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Don’t be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.”
